newsitem.title: UK: BOE set one dual, two single auctions for next qtr.
newsitem.headline: BOE set one dual, two single auctions for next qtr.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Thursday it has scheduled one dual and two single gilt auctions for the first quarter of the 1997/98 financial year.
The Bank said it well sell 7.0 percent stock due 2002 on Wednesday April, 23.
Its dual auction, comprising 7.0 percent gilts due 2002 and and 8.0 percent gilts of 2021 will take place on Tuesday, May 20 and Thursday, May 22.
It said it will then auction 7.25 percent stock due 2007 on Wednesday, June 25.
The Bank said details of the May and June auctions would be confirmed following the May 1 election.

The amounts to be auctioned in April will be announced on Tuesday, April 15. The dual auction details will be released on Tuesday, May 13 while the June auction amount will be unveiled on Tuesday, June 17.
